ops.title: Egress prototype B1 PASS: real-tun tailscale in apple/container fully works (join + MagicDNS + TCP-over-tun); metal pf IP-locks to hermes
ops.body:
Live test 2026-07-16 (ephemeral tag:hermes node in a minimal alpine container, `--cap-add NET_ADMIN`, real `--tun=tailscale0`, default NAT net). RESULT: real-tun tailscale in apple/container 1.1.0 FULLY works — this validates the Architecture B networking (supersedes the userspace-networking assumption; see [[apple/container real-tun works with --cap-add NET_ADMIN (resolves userspace-tailscale reachability)]]).

CONFIRMED:
- JOIN: node joined as hermes-egress-test (100.124.137.6), real tailscale0 tun UP (link/[65534]).
- MagicDNS: /etc/resolv.conf = tailscale-managed (100.100.100.100); `getent hosts metal` → 100.64.60.1. Works with real tun, no manual DNS config.
- TCP-over-tun to tailnet peers WORKS: bluebubbles:443 OPEN (ACL grants tag:hermes). So the agent's connect() to a tailnet peer over the tun works.
- Direct + DERP paths both work: metal via DERP(sfo) ~29ms, yasyf-home DIRECT via 192.168.4.24:41641 ~4ms, hermes via DERP ~19ms (tailscale ping).
- Default-route internet egress works: 1.1.1.1:443 OPEN — this is the leak the container-egress pf (2e) must block.

**metal TCP ports (8000/14322) timed out** — NOT a container/tun failure. tailscaled conn-track showed the SYN going out over a live tunnel (online=yes, lastRecv=5s) with no reply = metal's pf DROPPING it. Proven by asymmetry: same node reaches bluebubbles:443 (tag-based ACL) but not metal (IP-locked). metal's pf (darwin/metal.nix, H3/H4) admits ONLY the real hermes's specific IP (`tailscale ip -4 hermes` = 100.95.192.38) + the host to its 5 service ports, NOT tag:hermes.

**CUTOVER IMPLICATION (Phase 4a)**: metal's pf resolves `tailscale ip -4 hermes` → the IP of the tailnet node NAMED "hermes". So the container-hermes reaches metal ONLY once it IS the "hermes" node. At cutover: DELETE the old tart-hermes tailnet device so the container keeps the "hermes" MagicDNS name (not drift to hermes-1) — mirror scripts/remint-hermes-authkey.sh's note + deploy-vm.sh's device-delete. metal's 5-min pf refresh then resolves "hermes" → container IP → allows it. During Phase 3 parallel-run the container has a DIFFERENT identity, so it CANNOT reach metal's locked ports (expected) — validate metal-reachability at/after cutover, OR temporarily allow the container's IP on metal's pf for a pre-cutover e2e.

STILL PENDING (B2, needs host sudo): apply the container-egress pf allowlist (DERP-map IPs + controlplane/login.tailscale.com + WG udp/41641 + LAN direct; block other internet like 1.1.1.1) and verify the node STAYS joined + reachable under the narrow egress. This is now a 2e build+verify task, not a design-reshape risk (B1 proved the approach). Key minting is now self-service (cookiesync auth works → console API POST /admin/api/public/tailnet/-/keys/ with body {capabilities:{devices:{create:{ephemeral:true,reusable:false,preauthorized:true,tags:[tag:hermes]}}},expirySeconds:N}; key is at response .data.key).
